generic_domain.justification: Among the two domains provided, 'medical image analysis' is broader in scope compared to 'biomedical image analysis.' While both focus on analyzing images within the medical field, 'biomedical image analysis' typically integrates biological aspects into the imaging techniques, which could make it more specialized. On the other hand, 'medical image analysis' covers the interpretation and processing of a wide range of medical images from various modalities, such as X-rays, CT scans, MRIs, etc., making it more encompassing. Therefore, 'medical image analysis' serves as a better umbrella term that can include aspects from 'biomedical image analysis' if needed.
